_rubric: OSRS look out of 10: low poly + flat shading + per-face muted colours (3), chunky readable silhouette from the GAME camera and at 1x size (3), solid 3D volumes - no cardboard planes or pasted-on boxes (2), correct scale vs the 1.8 m figure + glow where needed (2). <8 = redo.

bank_booth.notes: desk + barred teller window + sign; gold arch replaced by a plain window rail (pass 2)

vault_chest.notes: iron-banded chest on stone plinth; lightened wood in pass 3 (read too black)

vault_door.notes: round steel door with wheel + bolts in a stone wall section; optional decor

furnace.notes: brick furnace + chimney; pass 1 had the fire mouth buried inside the body -> projecting firebox

anvil.notes: anvil on a rooted stump, hot bar glows, hammer + tongs

workbench.notes: bench with vice, saw, tool board

quench_bucket.notes: pass 1 lid cap hid the water -> open tub with cooling blade

wishing_well.notes: stone ring, glowing water, windlass + bucket, shingled roof (roof reads flatter from the game camera)

fountain.notes: octagonal basin, tiered bowl, glowing water sheets and ripples

shop_counter.notes: panelled counter, balance scales, cloth rolls, coin bowl

hearth.notes: pass 1 chimney breast was a plain grey block -> masonry courses, bigger fire

throne.notes: dais + carpet runner, crimson/gold throne with crest

banner_stand.notes: waved cloth strips with thickness, crown emblem, recolourable 'banner' material

banquet_table.notes: trestle table, runner, candelabra (glows), plates, goblets, roast

suit_of_armour.notes: plate armour with plume + halberd on a stand

chandelier.notes: iron ring, 6 glowing candles, hangs 2.1-3.6 m (overhead layer)

brazier.notes: tripod brazier with glowing coals + flame

cage_cat.notes: pass 1: flat roof panel + 6 bars hid a tiny cat -> gable roof, 5 bars, pet x1.3

cage_husky.notes: lying white husky with blue eyes (same cage fix)

cage_skeleton.notes: sitting skeleton pet, slate roof, iron bars (same cage fix)

cage_dragon.notes: green hatchling with wings, horns, egg shell (same cage fix)

pet_bed.notes: round cushion bed with ball + chew bone

dragon_hoard.notes: coin mounds, gold-banded chest, sword, shield, crown, gems

dragon_egg_nest.notes: charred stone ring, glowing embers, 3 speckled eggs, skull

goblin_campfire.notes: stone ring fire (glows), spit roast, log stools, pot

goblin_loot.notes: hide lean-to, sacks, broken crate, crude shield, spear

crypt_sarcophagus.notes: pass 1 faced end-on so the effigy was hidden -> turned 90 deg, bolder effigy, glowing candles

crypt_candelabra.notes: iron candelabra on a skull tripod (glows), two urns

spider_cocoons.notes: wrapped victims, strung cocoon, corner web, leg remains

spider_egg_sacs.notes: egg sac cluster with faint glow, web strands

void_altar.notes: runed altar (glows), floating crystal, forbidden tomes, obelisks; pass 2 removed a full-bright disc

void_crystals.notes: emissive crystal cluster on dark rock

giant_table.notes: 1.7 m high table, giant mug, drumstick, knife

giant_throne.notes: pass 1: flat grey pelt read as a wooden door -> bear pelt with head/claws, masonry seams, fur cushion

wolf_bone_pile.notes: bones, ribcage, antlered skull, blood stain

wolf_den_bed.notes: straw ring nest with sleeping pup
